extracted.name: Broccoli Slaw
extracted.description: This easy broccoli slaw recipe is a delicious side dish! We love packing it up for picnics and serving it at summer cookouts. To get 3 cups of julienned broccoli stems, you'll need 1 very large or 2 medium heads of broccoli.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup thinly sliced red onion
½ cup toasted sliced almonds (reserve some for garnish)
⅓ cup dried cranberries (reserve some for garnish)
1 recipe Coleslaw Dressing (omit the celery seed)
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, combine the broccoli stems, florets, carrots, cabbage, onion, almonds, and cranberries.
Drizzle with about ¾ of the dressing and toss to coat. Add more dressing, if desired. Garnish with the reserved almonds and cranberries and serve.
